repo.name: tc7200u-research
repo.purpose: Preserve TC7200U BCM3383 OpenWrt bring-up notes, logs, captures, images, reverse output, helper scripts, and patch copies for fast resumption.

layout.records: Single data bucket for notes, logs, captures, generated output, snapshots, binaries, reverse output, network scans, and backups.
layout.records/logs/serial: Picocom, UART, boot, and runtime serial logs.
layout.records/logs/tftp: Host TFTP, packet, route, neighbor, link, and ping proof captures in dated run folders.
layout.records/logs/builds: OpenWrt build, install, wrap, verify, and package-profile logs.
layout.records/generated: Manifests, state captures, hashes, generated measurements, and deep-mine output.
layout.records/network-scans: LAN, modem, and CFE/TFTP network scans.
layout.records/reverse: Reverse-engineering projects, labels, scripts, and extracted ProgramStore material.
layout.docs: Curated status, workflow, path, and topic docs.
layout.patches: OpenWrt patch copies and experiment patch sets.
layout.scripts: Single helper script plus host and serial command snippets.

execution_policy.script_runner: User runs scripts manually to save tokens.
execution_policy.ai_role: AI provides the exact prompts/commands to run and expected verification checks. AI should avoid auto-running scripts unless the user explicitly asks.

wrap: Serve /mnt/c/tftp/openwrt-(version nuber in hex).bin when testing with CFE.
capture_state: Run tcstate after a useful test.
Keep generated manifests and state captures in records/generated/.
gate_check: Keep reports in records/generated/ unless a different report path is explicitly supplied.

environment.RESEARCH: Optional helper override for repo path; default is ~/tc7200u-research.
environment.RECORDS_DIR: Optional helper override for records path; default is $RESEARCH/records.
environment.RESEARCH_NOTES_DIR: Optional helper override for generated output; default is $RECORDS_DIR/generated.
environment.RESEARCH_BUILDS_DIR: Optional helper override for build logs; default is $RECORDS_DIR/logs/builds.
environment.TC7200U_PACKAGE_PROFILE: Use fastboot by default; set debug for the larger diagnostics profile.

git.branch_policy: Use the current research branch unless the user asks to switch.
git.before_work: Run git status --short --branch and preserve existing dirty worktree content.
git.moves: Use git mv for tracked path moves when practical.
git.verification: Run relevant helper checks, JSON validation, markdown/path audits, and git diff --cached --check before committing.
git.commit: After verified work, run git add -A and create a local commit with a direct research-focused message.
git.push: Never push unless the user explicitly asks for a push.

working: A825 ProgramStore wrapper and verifier are integrated into the helper.
current_focus.blocker: BCM3383 GENET at 0x12c00000 probes and queues TX frames, but TDMA does not consume descriptors and RX remains zero.
current_focus.next_action: Continue kernel-side GENET descriptor width, DMA window, and clock/reset probing before switch integration.
